items.text: SQLite data plane: insert, query, count, delete
Decode a 1D barcode or 2D QR symbol from a still image, an injected code or the live camera. With no image and no injected value the call refuses instead of inventing a hit.
Drive the vibration actuator with semantic impacts, one-shot timings or a W3C waveform.
Synthesize a sine, square or triangle tone, or a short melodic sequence, through the audio actuator.
Capture a still frame or toggle the torch through the CameraX host. Without a host the call fails closed; no synthetic frame is returned.
Read and write files inside the workspace sandbox: write, read, append, copy, move, list, info, delete, mkdir, exists, uri.
Crop, resize, adjust colour, threshold, smooth or remove the background of an image and return the processed URI.
Embed text (512-d hashed fallback when the MediaPipe text JNI is absent) or an image descriptor, and score two texts for similarity.
Copy text to the system clipboard, paste it back, or clear it.
Ask the OS for device-credential confirmation. Without a host or a lock screen the call is denied; it never auto-approves.
Establish a Double-Ratchet session, encrypt, decrypt and verify a 60-digit safety number. The fleet acceptance flow is establish, encrypt, decrypt, verify.
Run the bundled MobileNetV4 ImageNet-1k classifier over a real image. It reports ImageNet labels, never a POS SKU, and refuses when it has no frame.
Salient-object segmentation. The U-2-Net weights are not bundled, so every call reports UNSUPPORTED with a reason and produces no mask URI.
Post a local notification into a channel with a priority.
Persist a page snapshot, report cache statistics, or clear the cache.
Open a websocket channel, subscribe, send a frame and disconnect. Without a reachable server the socket reports a failure rather than pretending to be connected.
HTTP GET, POST, download and upload plus the in-process LAN hub: serve, stop, status, share, list, unshare.
Scan for ESC/POS printers, pair, connect and print a receipt. With Bluetooth off the tool reports BLUETOOTH_OFF instead of a fake success.
Base64 and Base45 round trips plus the JSON transfer codec: validate, extract, stringify, chunk and assemble with a checksum.
Render a QR, EAN-13 or Code 128 symbol to a PNG and publish a decodable payload. 1D formats carry a quiet zone so the image scans back.
Keep the screen awake, capture a screenshot or start and stop a recording through the host sinks. With no host it fails closed.
Chart and list blocks fed by the live collection
